title: AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.20625v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are promising for alpha mining via combining financial priors, symbolic reasoning, executable factor generation, and feedback-driven refinement. Yet, they face a combinatorial search space, noisy non-stationary feedback, redundant discoveries, and overfitting risks from naively reusing past successes. To address these challenges, we propose AlphaMemo, a self-evolving alpha mining agent with Structured Search-Process Memory. Rather than memorizing only final factors or full trajectories, AlphaMemo records reusable evidence about which edit motifs work or fail under specific parent-factor contexts. It extracts motifs from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) differences, applies confidence-gated residual memory on top of a search-ledger prior, and uses asymmetric veto control to suppress high-confidence failure patterns. translated_title: AlphaMemo：面向自进化Alpha挖掘智能体的结构化搜索过程记忆
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通过结合金融先验知识、符号推理、可执行因子生成和反馈驱动的迭代改进，在Alpha挖掘领域展现出广阔前景。然而，它们面临着组合爆炸式的搜索空间、嘈杂且非平稳的反馈、冗余的因子发现，以及简单复用历史成功经验所带来的过拟合风险。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AlphaMemo，一个具有结构化搜索过程记忆的自进化Alpha挖掘智能体。与仅仅记忆最终因子或完整轨迹不同，AlphaMemo记录的是可复用的证据，即哪些编辑模式在特定的父因子上下文中有效或失败。它从抽象语法树（AST）差异中提取编辑模式，在搜索账本先验之上应用置信度门控的残差记忆，并采用非对称否决控制机制来抑制高置信度的失败模式。在中证500和标普500指数上的实验表明，该方法的样本外表现和固定预算下的因子发现效率均得到提升。
tldr: AlphaMemo通过从AST差异中提取编辑模式、置信度门控残差记忆和非对称否决控制构建结构化搜索过程记忆，实现了自进化的Alpha挖掘智能体，在中证500和标普500上显著提升了样本外表现和固定预算下的因子发现效率。
en_tdlr: AlphaMemo introduces Structured Search-Process Memory that extracts edit motifs from AST differences, applies confidence-gated residual memory and asymmetric veto control, enabling self-evolving alpha mining agents with improved out-of-sample performance and fixed-budget discovery efficiency on CSI 500 and S&P 500.
